versions.changelog: v2.9: Leaderboard, Owner consciousness, 10 company methodologies, real user frustration triggers, security fix, blog

**Summary: Adds "验证型" corporate rhetoric and stricter action requirements when claiming completion without evidence.**

- New "阿里味·验证型"、"华为味·验证型"、"字节味·验证型"、"腾讯味·验证型" PUA rhetoric packages added, targeting claims of completion without running/checking outputs.
- Updated "能动性等级"、"主动出击清单"、"抗合理化表"，强调“用工具验证”与贴出 build/test/curl 等实际输出结果为完成标准。
- 明确要求交付需自证“已运行”、“有证据”，并在多处补充针对未验证即声称完成的批评与流程指引。
- 补充针对“改完代码不 build、不 test、不 curl 就交付”等被动行为的批判和处理规则。
